alas, ah, an interjection of one grieving, pitying, or wondering.

Suidas φεῦ [alas]: an adverb of lamentation (σχετλιασμοῦ [of lamentation] in Hesychius), or a painful wail. Hesychius φεῦ φεῦ [alas, alas]: equal to οἴμοι [woe is me]. The use of this interjection is very frequent in tragedy, in dialogue as well as in lyric songs, and in such a way that sometimes the simple φεῦ [alas], sometimes the doubled φεῦ φεῦ [alas, alas] is placed either within or outside the verse: on which see the Thesaurus vol. 8 p. 726.
It is placed outside the verse.
